note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 7 May 1936. One new member, Mr. William Porter, was returned for Ballykeel; in the other nine divisions (Ballymacbrennan, Ballyskeagh, Blaris, Breda, Carryduff, Dromara, Drumbo, Edenderry, Hillsborough) the sitting members were automatically returned, five of whom are recorded from Lisburn Standard reports of the June and July 1936 meetings (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Polling in County Down was fixed for 28 May 1936. 'Aughnaleck, Lisburn' in the list is John Martin's address (Anahilt), not a division. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
